thread.title: Apple CEO Tim Cook wants to end money - and everyone working in financial technology should be paying attention (AAPL)

author: Kif Leswing
title: Apple CEO Tim Cook wants to end money - and everyone working in financial technology should be paying attention (AAPL)
text: Apple CEO Tim Cook wants to end money — and everyone working in financial technology should be paying attention (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Feb 24, 2018, 8:30 am 28 pts Apple's CEO says he hopes to be alive to see the end of money. 16% of iPhone users have Apple Pay turned on, according to a recent estimate from Loup Ventures. Apple Pay is a project that doesn't need to generate large revenue. If Apple CEO Tim Cook had his way, he would never use cash again…
